title: Why Do Dogs Yawn So Much?

script: Dogs yawn a lot more than just when they're sleepy. Yawning is actually one of the clearest calming signals in a dog's body language toolkit. When a dog feels a little stressed, unsure, or overstimulated, like during a vet visit or a tense moment with another dog, they'll often yawn to self-soothe and lower their own stress levels. It's also socially contagious. Studies have shown dogs yawn in response to their owners yawning, and dogs who are more closely bonded to their humans yawn back more often, which suggests a real level of empathy behind it. So next time your dog yawns in a stressful moment, that's them self-soothing, not boredom. Want more dog behavior tips like this? Link's in the bio.
